records.title: Domain abstractions are not uniformly excellent
records.summary: Legacy VOP parameters, calculation boundaries, result shapes, package imports and issue governance do not yet consistently enforce the typed contracts already present at the Arrow interoperability boundary.
records.question: Are concerns, parameters, calculations, backend capabilities and results uniformly represented by strict, immutable, portable and provenance-bearing contracts?
records.impact_if_unresolved: Scientific meaning and compatibility can drift behind modern tooling, leaving runtime dictionaries and duplicate modules as ungoverned alternative interfaces.
resolution_criteria: Canonical typed governance and analysis contracts validate in both repositories.
A capability-aware kernel slice preserves legacy numerical parity.
VOP has one canonical package implementation with tested migration shims.
GitHub issue and Project projections are privacy-safe and conflict-aware.
All focused, full and hosted gates pass.

records.title: Typed governance contract implementation
records.summary: Committed strict Pydantic v2 governance models, deterministic schemas and privacy-safe projection tests.
